items.funEn: Eyebrow ink came in grades, and the grades tracked money. Luozi dai at the top, copper-based dai below it, then plain graphite, and at the bottom a charred willow twig. A single grooming item could be laid out across four or five price tiers — which is roughly how lipstick works now.

items.histZh: 龙胆紫取龙胆科植物的花色，是带蓝的紫，比丁香色浓、比紫棠亮。龙胆在中国本草里是药，根极苦，名字里的「龙胆」说的就是这个苦法。颜色上它偏冷，属于紫里比较克制的一档。注意有一种同名的药用染料也叫龙胆紫（甲紫），那是合成品，颜色比这个艳得多，别混。屏幕上的值是按花色取的。
items.histEn: Gentian violet is the colour of the gentian blossom: a blue-leaning purple, deeper than lilac and brighter than the shade called purple pear. In Chinese materia medica gentian is a medicine and the root is extraordinarily bitter, which is what the name gentian — dragon's gall — is describing. As a colour it runs cool, one of the more restrained purples. Note that a synthetic antiseptic dye shares the name; it is far more vivid and should not be confused with the flower. The value here is taken from the blossom.
items.funZh: 龙胆在野外长在高海拔，花却常常是闭合的钟形，只在有太阳时张开。这种「天晴才开」的习性让它在高山植物里很出名 —— 想看它开花，得赌对天气和时段，比看别的花要多一点运气。
items.funEn: Gentians grow high and their flowers are often closed bells that open only in sun. Among alpine plants that habit is well known, and seeing one open means betting correctly on both the weather and the hour — more luck than most flowers demand.

items.histZh: 紫藤色取紫藤花垂下来的那一串，是偏蓝的浅紫，比雪青深、比丁香色冷。紫藤在中文里是实打实的名花，苏州的几株老藤有几百年历史，花期一到就压满整条廊架。颜色上它介于蓝紫和紫之间，是传统紫里最轻的一档之一。屏幕上的紫藤色按盛花取色，初开时更蓝。
items.histEn: Wisteria takes its colour from the hanging racemes of the vine: a blue-leaning pale purple, deeper than snow-lilac and cooler than lilac proper. Wisteria is a serious flower in China — several vines in Suzhou are centuries old and bury an entire pergola when they bloom. The colour sits between blue-violet and violet, and is among the lightest of the traditional purples. This sample is at full bloom; the earliest flowers are bluer.
items.funZh: 紫藤的花是从上往下依次开的，所以同一串上颜色并不一致：上面先开、颜色淡，下面还含着苞、颜色深。画一串紫藤只用一种紫，多半是偷懒 —— 真东西是渐变的。
items.funEn: Wisteria opens from the top of the raceme downward, so a single cluster is never one colour: the upper flowers are already pale and open while the lower ones are still tight buds and therefore darker. Painting a wisteria cluster in a single purple is a shortcut. The real thing is a gradient.

items.histZh: 葡萄紫取成熟紫葡萄的果皮颜色，是带红的深紫。葡萄经西域传入中原是汉代的事，此后果与酒一起进入了诗文，葡萄紫也逐渐成了一个固定的色名，常用来形容深色织物和帐幕。它的紫里有一层暗红，很沉。屏幕上的葡萄紫按紫皮葡萄取色，果霜没擦掉时其实更偏灰蓝。
items.histEn: Grape purple is the skin of a ripe purple grape: a deep purple with red in it. The fruit reached the central plains from the western regions in the Han period, after which grapes and wine entered Chinese poetry together, and grape purple settled into the vocabulary as a fixed term for dark textiles and hangings. There is a layer of dark red inside the purple, which keeps it heavy. This sample is from purple-skinned fruit; with the natural bloom left on, it reads greyer and bluer.
items.funZh: 果皮上的那层白霜是酵母，不是脏东西 —— 传统酿酒根本不洗葡萄就是为的这个。同一串葡萄，擦掉霜和留着霜，颜色差得像两种水果，葡萄紫这个色名到底指哪一种，其实一直含糊。
items.funEn: The powdery bloom on grape skins is yeast, not dirt, which is why traditional winemaking does not wash the fruit at all. Wipe the bloom off and the same cluster reads as a different fruit entirely. Which of the two grape purple actually names has never been settled.

items.histZh: 玫瑰紫是钧窑瓷器上的名釉之一，紫里透红，像玫瑰花瓣压暗了的样子。钧窑靠铜在还原气氛中发色，同一窑不同位置温差极大，所以玫瑰紫从来没有两块一模一样 —— 窑变的意思正在于此。这个色名与其说是颜色，不如说是一类釉面描述的统称。屏幕上的值按典型器取色。
items.histEn: Rose purple is one of the celebrated glazes of Jun ware, a red-flecked purple something like a darkened rose petal. Jun glazes get their colour from copper fired in a reducing atmosphere, and because the temperature varies sharply across a single kiln, no two pieces of rose purple are identical — which is exactly what the term kiln transmutation means. The name describes a family of surfaces rather than a single colour. The value shown is taken from a representative piece.
items.funZh: 钧窑最出名的一句是「入窑一色，出窑万彩」：同一批坯子涂同样的釉，出来可能一件偏红、一件偏蓝。原因除了温度不均，还在于铜的呈色对气氛极其敏感 —— 窑里多一点或少一点一氧化碳，结果就换了个颜色。
items.funEn: The standard line about Jun ware is that one colour goes into the kiln and ten thousand come out. A batch of identical bodies and glazes can yield one piece veering red, another veering blue. Temperature is only half of it: copper colouring is acutely sensitive to atmosphere, so a little more or less carbon monoxide inside the kiln simply changes the answer.

items.histZh: 茄紫取紫皮茄子的颜色，是暗而闷的紫，比葡萄紫更冷、更灰。茄子在传统色里属于「菜蔬色」那一支，跟葱绿、韭黄是同一路数，都以身边实物为参照。它出现的场合多是深色衣料和旧器物的描述，很少用来形容鲜艳的东西。屏幕上的茄紫按成熟紫茄取色，实际果皮有蜡质反光，颜色随角度变。
items.histEn: Aubergine purple is the colour of a purple aubergine skin: dark, dull, cooler and greyer than grape purple. It belongs to the vegetable branch of the traditional vocabulary, alongside scallion green and chive yellow, all of them calibrated against objects close at hand. It turns up mostly in descriptions of dark cloth and old objects, rarely of anything brilliant. This sample is a ripe aubergine; the real skin carries a waxy sheen that shifts the colour with the viewing angle.
items.funZh: 「茄紫」和「玫瑰紫」放在一起很能说明传统色名的粗糙之处：一个描述闷暗的菜皮，一个描述瓷器釉面，两者的明度和饱和都差得远，但因为都含「紫」字，常被写在同一份色卡里并列，看上去像是同一档。
items.funEn: Set aubergine purple beside rose purple and the looseness of the whole vocabulary shows. One describes a dull vegetable skin, the other a ceramic glaze; they differ widely in both lightness and saturation. But because both words contain purple, they get listed side by side on the same card and read as though they were neighbours.

items.histZh: 紫茉莉的花色，是浓而不正的紫，红紫之间。这种花傍晚才开、天亮就收，所以又叫「晚饭花」「洗澡花」—— 名字里全是生活作息。它原产热带美洲，明代前后传入中国，很快在庭院里普及，连种子里的白粉都被人当粉搽脸用，所以又叫胭脂花。屏幕上的紫茉莉按傍晚初开时取色，白天闭合时颜色更淡。
items.histEn: Mirabilis purple is the colour of the four o'clock flower: a strong, slightly unbalanced purple sitting between red and violet. The plant opens at dusk and closes at dawn, which is why Chinese folk names for it translate as dinner flower and bath flower — a colour named after household routine. It came originally from tropical America and spread through Chinese courtyards around the Ming, common enough that the white powder inside its seeds was used as face powder. This sample is taken at dusk; closed in daylight, the flower fades.
items.funZh: 紫茉莉的不同植株花色不一样，同一批种子里能出紫、红、黄、白好几色，而且花是逐朵开、不集中，所以一丛里往往同时挂着几种颜色。想拿它当单一色名的依据，本身就有点勉强 —— 传统色里这种「一物多色」的情况不少。
items.funEn: Different plants of the four o'clock flower produce different colours, and a single sowing can yield purple, red, yellow and white together, with the flowers opening one at a time rather than as a cohort. Using it as the basis for a single colour word is therefore a stretch, though that kind of one-plant-many-colours looseness runs all through the traditional vocabulary.

items.histZh: 桔梗紫取桔梗花的花色，是偏蓝的紫，比雪青沉、比青莲冷。桔梗在中国既是野花也是药材，根部入药，朝鲜半岛还把它做成小菜。花在含苞时鼓起像个小灯笼，所以英文叫 balloon flower。它开在夏末，色偏冷，跟同时节的暖色调正好相反。屏幕上的桔梗紫按盛花取色。
items.histEn: Platycodon violet is the colour of the balloon flower: a blue-leaning purple, heavier than snow-lilac and cooler than the shade called lotus. The plant is both a wildflower and a medicine in China, its root prescribed and also pickled as a side dish in Korea. The buds inflate into little lanterns before opening, which is where the English name comes from. It flowers at the end of summer, unusually cool-toned for its season. This sample is at full bloom.
items.funZh: 桔梗的花蕾是闭合的钟形，鼓起来之后才裂开五瓣，所以一朵花在几天里要从「灯笼」变成「星」。这种从闭合到张开的形变让它成了不少植物画里的偏爱对象 —— 画一朵等于画了两种形态。
items.funEn: A platycodon bud is a closed bell that inflates and then splits into five points, so one flower goes from lantern to star across a few days. That transformation made it a favourite of botanical illustrators, since a single drawing could capture both states.

items.histZh: 菖蒲紫取菖蒲的花色，是暗而偏灰的紫。菖蒲在中国节令里跟艾草是一对，端午要悬在门上，取它的气味辟秽。它的叶细长挺直，古人拿它比喻刚直，所谓「菖蒲之节」。颜色上这一档紫没什么锋头，属于紫里带土的一路。屏幕上的菖蒲紫按花期取色，日常看到的菖蒲叶其实是不太起眼的青绿。
items.histEn: Sweet flag purple is the flower: a dark, grey-leaning violet. Sweet flag is paired with mugwort in the Chinese ritual calendar, hung on doors at the Dragon Boat Festival for its scent, which is believed to drive off bad air. Its leaves are long, narrow and upright, and classical writers used them as an emblem of unbending character. As a colour it is unassertive, one of the earthier violets. This sample is from the flowering phase; the leaves one sees most of the year are a plainer blue-green.
items.funZh: 菖蒲的花其实很小，长在叶间的一个肉穗上，不特意找很难注意到 —— 所以「菖蒲紫」这个色名流传度远不如菖蒲本身。中文里不少色名都是这样：物比色出名，颜色只是附带的注解。
items.funEn: Sweet flag flowers are small, crowded onto a fleshy spike tucked among the leaves, and easy to miss unless you go looking. That is why the colour term is far less familiar than the plant. A good many Chinese colour words work this way: the object is famous and the shade is a footnote to it.

items.histZh: 紫檀色取紫檀木心材的颜色，是发暗的紫褐，不鲜，但极沉稳。紫檀生长极慢，寸木寸金，明清家具里最贵重的一档就是它，用久了表面会起一层包浆，颜色比新料更深、更透。所以「紫檀色」其实不是一个固定的值，而是从新料到老器之间的一大段。屏幕上的值取的是老家具的包浆色。
items.histEn: Rosewood purple is the heartwood of the rosewood tree: a dark violet-brown, never bright, extremely sober. The tree grows so slowly that a small piece is worth a great deal, and rosewood is the most prized timber in Ming and Qing furniture. Handled over decades it develops a patina that reads deeper and more translucent than fresh stock, so rosewood purple is a span rather than a value, running from newly cut wood to a well-used piece. The sample shown is the patina of old furniture.
items.funZh: 紫檀的木材本身并不紫，切开的断面是橙红的，颜色是在空气和光里慢慢转深的 —— 也就是「氧化」。所以一件紫檀家具的颜色有一半是时间给的，这也是老料比新料贵的原因之一，买的是那几十年的色。
items.funEn: Rosewood is not purple when it is cut; a fresh surface is orange-red and darkens over years in air and light through oxidation. Half the colour of a rosewood piece is therefore contributed by time, which is part of why old stock commands its price: what is being bought is several decades of colour.

items.histZh: 佛头青原本是石青里的一个等级名，指最纯最浓的那一层蓝，因为常用在佛像的头髻上，所以叫佛头青。它比普通的石青更深、更偏紫，在壁画里用来压住整幅的暗部。敦煌和各地寺观壁画上的这个蓝，不少就是磨得很细的石青反复罩染出来的。屏幕上的值按壁画取色，矿物颗粒越粗颜色越深。
items.histEn: Buddha's head blue began as a grade name for azurite — the purest, deepest layer of the blue — because it was used on the hair knots of Buddha figures, which is where the name comes from. It runs darker and more violet than ordinary azurite and was used in wall painting to hold down the shadows of a whole composition. A great deal of the blue at Dunhuang and in temple murals across China is azurite ground very fine and glazed in repeated layers. This value comes from mural work; the coarser the mineral grain, the deeper the colour.
items.funZh: 石青研磨后会分层：越粗越深蓝，越细越浅白。所以古代画工磨一罐石青，能按粒度分出好几个色阶，粗的给衣纹，细的给天空。所谓「佛头青」在这套分级里差不多是最粗、最贵的那一档。
items.funEn: Ground azurite settles into grades: the coarser the grain the deeper the blue, the finer the paler, until it is nearly white. A painter grinding a single batch could therefore separate several steps out of it, coarse for drapery folds and fine for sky. Buddha's head blue is roughly the coarsest and costliest step in that sequence.

items.histZh: 秘色是越窑专供皇室的青瓷釉色，名字里的「秘」历来有两种解释：一说釉料配方秘不外传，一说这颜色本身就难以言状。它在唐代就被写进诗里，「九秋风露越窑开，夺得千峰翠色来」，说的是同一件事。秘色青得极淡、带灰，几乎接近玉。屏幕上的值按法门寺出土的实物取色。
items.histEn: Mise is the glaze colour of celadon made at the Yue kilns for the imperial court. The word secret in the name has two standing explanations: that the glaze recipe was kept from outsiders, or that the colour itself defied description. Tang poetry already celebrated it — nine autumns of wind and dew, the Yue kiln opens and takes the green of a thousand peaks. Mise is an extremely pale, greyish green, closer to jade than to any plant. This value is taken from pieces excavated at Famen Temple.
items.funZh: 秘色瓷长期只是文献里的一个词，没人知道实物长什么样，直到 1987 年法门寺地宫打开，出土的器物跟一块记事碑上的「瓷秘色」对上了号，这个色名才算落地。也就是说，我们对这个颜色的认识，是四十年前才补上的。
items.funEn: For centuries mise existed only as a phrase in documents, with nobody able to say what the objects looked like — until the crypt at Famen Temple was opened in 1987 and the vessels inside matched an inventory tablet listing secret-colour ware. That is when the term acquired a body. Our understanding of this colour is roughly forty years old.

items.histZh: 缥是青白色的丝帛，色在青与白之间，淡得发亮。「缥碧」这个词常用来形容浅而清的绿水，郦道元写富春江「水皆缥碧，千丈见底」，用的正是它。缥色在汉唐的织物里都算高档，因为它需要反复漂洗才能出那种透亮。屏幕上的缥色按古绢取色，旧绢年份一久会转黄。
items.histEn: Piao names silk of a pale blue-green, a colour sitting between green and white, washed so light it seems to give off light. The compound piao-bi is used of clear shallow water; the geographer Li Daoyuan described the Fuchun River as piao-bi, transparent to the bottom through a thousand feet. In Han and Tang textiles the shade was a luxury, since only repeated rinsing produces that translucency. This value is from old silk, which yellows as it ages.
items.funZh: 「缥」这个字后来主要活在两个地方：一个是「缥缃」，指淡青和浅黄两种书卷封皮的颜色，慢慢成了书籍的代称；另一个是「缥缈」—— 形容若有若无，正是从这种淡到快没了的感觉引申出来的。
items.funEn: The character survived mainly in two places. One is the phrase for pale blue-green and pale yellow book wrappers, which came to stand for books generally. The other is the word for faint and insubstantial, misty, barely there — an extension of exactly that quality of being washed almost to nothing.

items.histZh: 空青是一种天然产出的蓝铜矿，中空成块，敲开里面往往含水，古人因此认为它能治眼病 —— 《本草纲目》里就把它归到眼科用药里。颜色是鲜而不深的青蓝，比石青亮得多。它极稀有，古代文献里常把它跟金玉并列，说「空青难得」。屏幕上的空青按新鲜断面取色，久置会失水转暗。
items.histEn: Hollow azurite is a naturally formed nodule of the mineral azurite, hollow inside and often holding water, which led Chinese physicians to prescribe it for the eyes; the great pharmacopoeia Bencao Gangmu files it among ophthalmic drugs. Its colour is a bright, shallow cyan-blue, much lighter than pigment-grade azurite. It is extremely rare, which is why older texts rank it alongside gold and jade as a thing rarely obtained. This sample is from a fresh fracture; exposed, it loses water and darkens.
items.funZh: 空青之所以被当成眼科药，逻辑其实是「同气相求」：它是青色的、又是中空的，而眼睛的瞳孔古人叫「青睛」，两样一对应，药性就被推出来了。这种以形补形的思路在传统药物里很普遍，跟颜色本身没关系。
items.funEn: The reasoning behind prescribing it for eyes is analogical rather than chemical: the mineral is green-blue and hollow, and the pupil of the eye was called the green-blue point, so the correspondence was taken to imply a use. That habit of matching appearances to organs runs right through traditional pharmacology, with colour doing the matching.

items.histZh: 晴山蓝说的是晴天望远的山色 —— 因为空气散射，山不会是真绿，而是越来越蓝、越来越淡。这在绘画里是个老题目：「远山如黛」讲的是同一件事，只不过黛说的是更暗的那一头。晴山蓝属于典型的「因距离而产生的颜色」，不是某一种物体的固有色。屏幕上的值按中等距离的山脊取色。
items.histEn: Clear mountain blue is what hills look like at a distance on a fine day: because of atmospheric scattering, a far ridge is not truly green but progressively bluer and paler. Painting has long treated this as its own problem, and the classical phrase about distant hills looking like daimei — eyebrow ink — is describing the same effect at its darker end. It is a colour produced by distance rather than belonging to an object. The sample is taken from a ridge at middling range.
items.funZh: 这种因大气散射而来的蓝是画家的一道分水岭：不懂的人会把远山画成绿加灰，懂的人知道那其实是往蓝走。所以「远山」在中国山水画里从来不是绿色的，哪怕近处的树全画成绿。
items.funEn: This scattering blue is a dividing line between painters. The inexperienced add grey to green for distant hills; the experienced know the move is toward blue. That is why distant ridges in Chinese landscape painting are never green, even when every tree in the foreground is.

items.histZh: 孔雀蓝取孔雀尾羽的颜色，是蓝绿之间最深的那一档。它跟孔雀石是两回事：孔雀石是含铜的绿色矿物，孔雀蓝说的是羽毛，色偏青得多。这个色名在明清的瓷釉和织物里出现，常用来形容带光变效果的深青。屏幕上的孔雀蓝按羽毛正面取色，羽色随角度从蓝翻到绿，是结构色不是色素色。
items.histEn: Peacock blue is the colour of the tail feather: the deepest step between blue and green. It has nothing to do with malachite, which is a copper-bearing green mineral; peacock blue names the feather and runs far more cyan. The term appears on Ming and Qing glazes and textiles, usually describing a deep bluish green with an iridescent shift. This sample is the feather face-on; the colour swings from blue to green with the viewing angle, because it is structural rather than pigmented.
items.funZh: 孔雀羽毛的蓝绿会随角度翻转，是因为羽枝里有一层极细的角质结构，光在上面发生干涉 —— 颜色是「形状」造出来的，不是颜料染上去的。所以羽毛磨碎之后，那种蓝绿就消失了，剩下一堆褐色的粉末。
items.funEn: Peacock blue flips with the viewing angle because the barbules contain a fine keratin structure that interferes with light. The colour is made by shape rather than laid on as pigment, which is why grinding the feather destroys it: what remains is a heap of brown powder.

items.histZh: 豆青是青瓷里偏灰偏白的一档釉色，最典型的出处是龙泉窑。它浅到接近白，但绝不是白：把一件豆青瓷器放在白纸上，那层青立刻显出来。青瓷的呈色靠铁，还原程度深浅之间能拉出一长串色阶，豆青、粉青、梅子青基本上就是这条线上的几个位置。屏幕上的值按龙泉豆青器取色。
items.histEn: Pea green is one of the pale, greyish glazes of Chinese celadon, and its classic source is the Longquan kilns. It is light enough to border on white, yet it is never white: set a piece on white paper and the green immediately declares itself. Celadon colour comes from iron, and the degree of reduction pulls out a long ladder of shades — pea green, powder blue, plum green are essentially positions along that one line. This value is taken from a Longquan piece.
items.funZh: 判断一件青瓷是豆青还是粉青，行家常把器物放在白纸上比 —— 因为釉层很薄、颜色很淡，只看物件本身容易被环境光骗过去。一个颜色要比较出高下，往往得先给个中性的底。
items.funEn: To decide whether a celadon is pea green or powder blue, connoisseurs set the piece on white paper. The glaze is thin and the colour pale, so against anything else ambient light is enough to mislead the eye. Comparing two very light colours generally requires supplying a neutral ground first.

items.histZh: 葱青和葱绿其实分在两个色系：葱绿是叶身偏黄的那一面，葱青说的是叶鞘附近偏青、偏蓝的那一段。所以同一根葱从头到尾能排出好几档色名。葱青常用来形容浅而冷的青绿，瓷釉、纱料和淡彩都用它。屏幕上的葱青按叶鞘处取色，光线不同会有明显偏移。
items.histEn: Scallion cyan and scallion green belong to different families: the green names the yellower part of the leaf blade, while the cyan names the bluer, more teal section near the sheath. A single scallion can therefore supply several colour words along its length. Scallion cyan is used of light, cool blue-greens, on glazes, gauzes and pale painting. This sample is taken at the sheath, where the reading swings noticeably with the light.
items.funZh: 「青葱」这个词今天用来形容年轻，源头却真的是颜色 —— 古书里写少年「青葱」是说气色像新发的葱。后来才从「看着嫩」引申成「年纪轻」，颜色彻底退到了比喻后面。
items.funEn: The Chinese word for fresh and youthful is built out of this plant. Older texts describe young people as scallion-coloured, meaning their complexion like new growth; only later did the phrase slide from looking tender to being young, with the colour retiring entirely behind the metaphor.

items.histZh: 水色是浅青近白的一档，取的是浅水在日光下透出来的那种颜色。它在传统色里属于「白中带色」，跟月白、雪白、霜色是一类：单看几乎是白的，放到别的白旁边才显出青。这类颜色在实际染作里最难做，因为稍微一深就掉出这个区间。屏幕上的水色按浅水取色，水深一点就变成完全不同的绿。
items.histEn: Water colour is a pale, almost white blue-green, taken from shallow water in daylight. It belongs with moon-white, snow-white and frost white among the near-whites: seen alone it is practically white, and only beside another white does the blue declare itself. This is the hardest band to hit in actual dyeing, because a single step deeper drops straight out of the range. The sample here is shallow water; a little more depth and it becomes a different colour altogether.
items.funZh: 近白色之间的差别靠比较而不是靠记忆：单独给你一块水色，多数人会说是白；并排摆上象牙白、霜色、月白，差别立刻出来。所以传统色卡里最有用的部分往往是最浅的那几格，也最容易被当成「都是白」。
items.funEn: Distinguishing near-whites depends on comparison rather than memory. Shown one swatch of water colour, most people call it white; line it up beside ivory, frost and moon-white and the differences appear at once. The palest blocks on a traditional colour card are often the most useful and the most often dismissed as all just white.

items.histZh: 鸦青说的是乌鸦羽毛上那层暗蓝的金属光泽 —— 远看是黑，凑近了才看出蓝。传统色里专有一批这样的「黑里带色」：鸦青、鸦黄、鸦绿，都从乌鸦羽色的光变里来。鸦青常用来形容深色的头发和织物，也用来写夜色。屏幕上的鸦青取的是羽毛反光最强的那一面，平视时它接近纯黑。
items.histEn: Crow blue is the dark metallic sheen on a crow's feather: black at a distance, blue only when you get close. Chinese has a small family of names built this way — crow blue, crow yellow, crow green — all drawn from the iridescence of the same bird. Crow blue describes dark hair and dark cloth, and it describes night. The sample is the feather at its most reflective; seen flat-on it is very nearly black.
items.funZh: 鸦羽的蓝绿光泽跟孔雀羽毛是一个原理，都是结构色，只不过乌鸦的结构层更密，干涉出来的波长更短、更暗，所以只在特定角度才闪。这也解释了为什么「乌鸦是黑的」和「鸦青是蓝的」两句话都不算错。
items.funEn: The blue-green sheen on a crow works the same way as a peacock's tail, by structural interference; the crow's layers are denser, throwing a shorter and darker wavelength, which is why it flashes only at particular angles. It also explains why both statements — a crow is black, and crow blue is blue — are correct.

items.histZh: 青梅色取未成熟梅子的表皮，是明亮的黄绿。青梅在中国文化里分量很重：它既是「青梅竹马」里的那个青梅，也是煮酒论英雄时下酒的东西，还是「望梅止渴」里让人流口水的那个。颜色上它偏亮偏嫩，是黄绿里最容易被记住的一档。屏幕上的青梅按挂果期取色，熟透的梅子转黄。
items.histEn: Green plum is the skin of an unripe plum: a bright yellow-green. The fruit carries real weight in Chinese culture — it is the plum in the phrase for childhood sweethearts, the fruit consumed while the two rivals for empire discussed heroes over drinks, and the one that made marching soldiers salivate at the mere thought of it. As a colour it runs light and tender, the most memorable of the yellow-greens. This sample is from fruit still on the tree; fully ripe, a plum turns yellow.
items.funZh: 「望梅止渴」在生理上是站得住的：酸味在想象里就能触发唾液分泌，这属于条件反射。所以曹操那句空口许诺不一定纯属忽悠 —— 在那个时刻，士兵嘴里确实会有点东西。
items.funEn: The old story about curing thirst by imagining plums holds up physiologically: sourness triggers salivation from imagination alone, which is a conditioned reflex. Cao Cao's empty promise may therefore not have been pure bluff — for a moment his soldiers genuinely had something in their mouths.

items.histZh: 芥黄取芥末的颜色，是发暗发土的一档黄，比藤黄闷得多。芥菜在中国是极普通的作物，种子磨成末既是调料也是药，所以这个色名带着强烈的日常气。它属于「不讨喜但耐看」的黄：明度低、饱和低，用在织物上显得旧而稳。屏幕上的芥黄按芥末糊取色，新鲜粉末要更亮更黄。
items.histEn: Mustard yellow takes the colour of the prepared condiment: a dark, earthy yellow, much duller than gamboge. Mustard is an unremarkable crop in China, its ground seed serving at once as seasoning and medicine, so the colour word carries a strong domestic flavour. It is a yellow that is not obviously appealing and yet wears well — low in lightness and saturation, it makes cloth look old and settled. This sample is prepared mustard; the fresh powder is brighter and sandier.
items.funZh: 黄色在传统色里普遍偏亮，芥黄是少数几档「暗黄」之一。这类色在应用上有个好处：衬肤色不挑人，也不像正黄那样一上身就把人照亮。所以旧时的窗帘、桌布、长衫常往这个方向走。
items.funEn: Yellows in the traditional palette tend to be bright; mustard is one of the few dark ones. That carries practical advantages, since it flatters most complexions and does not, like a pure yellow, flood everything around it with light. It is why old curtains, tablecloths and long gowns so often drifted in this direction.

items.histZh: 芸黄取芸香花的颜色，是柔和的浅黄。芸香是古代书斋里的常客：它气味浓，能驱虫，所以藏书的人家在书柜里放芸香草，翻书时常带出这种味道，「书香」之说多少跟它有关。芸黄因此带着一层书卷气，颜色本身却只是温和的暖黄。屏幕上的芸黄按盛花取色。
items.histEn: Yun yellow is the colour of the rue flower: a soft, light yellow. Rue was a fixture of the Chinese study, strong-smelling enough to drive off insects, so households with libraries kept it among the shelves and the smell came out whenever a book was opened — which is part of where the phrase the scent of books comes from. The colour accordingly carries a scholarly air, though in itself it is only a gentle warm yellow. This sample is at full bloom.
items.funZh: 「芸」在古书里还常跟校对连在一起：「芸阁」「芸台」都是藏书和校书机构的别称，校书郎有时也被叫作「芸香吏」。一个因为防虫而进书柜的植物，最后进了官职名称。
items.funEn: The character for rue also attached itself to editorial work: the rue pavilion and the rue terrace were bywords for libraries and the offices that collated texts, and a proofreader could be called a rue official. A plant brought into the bookcase for pest control ended up inside a job title.

items.histZh: 檀香色比檀色浅、偏黄，取的是檀香木刨开后的表面，也兼顾了香灰那种暖白。它常出现在衣服和帐幔的描述里，属于低调的暖调中间色，既不抢眼也不显脏。传统色里「香色」一支全都偏暖偏灰，檀香色是其中的典型。屏幕上的值按木料新刨面取色，经过打磨上蜡的木器要深一档。
items.histEn: Sandalwood incense is lighter and yellower than the shade called sandal, taken from a freshly planed surface of the wood while also nodding at the warm white of incense ash. It turns up on clothing and hangings as a subdued warm middle tone, neither eye-catching nor dingy. The whole incense branch of the traditional vocabulary runs warm and greyish, and this is its standard example. The value shown is new-planed timber; polished and waxed wood reads a step deeper.
items.funZh: 檀香木的香味主要来自心材里的挥发油，越靠中心越浓，所以一棵树的边材几乎无味。古董家具上那种经年的香气，往往来自某几块料，不是整件都香 —— 鼻子找得比眼睛准。
items.funEn: The scent of sandalwood comes from volatile oil in the heartwood, richest at the centre, so the outer sapwood is nearly odourless. The lingering fragrance of an old piece of furniture typically comes from a few specific boards rather than the whole object — the nose locating what the eye cannot.

items.histZh: 蛋黄是明亮而饱和的暖黄，取自蛋卵的黄。它属于最没有门槛的色名之一 —— 人人都见过实物，不需要解释。传统色里这一类「食物色」很多：蛋黄、蟹壳、鸭卵、豆沙、蜜色，都用日常吃食当参照。屏幕上的蛋黄按新鲜蛋取色，蛋黄的颜色其实随饲料变化很大。
items.histEn: Egg yolk is a bright, saturated warm yellow, taken from the yolk itself. It is among the most accessible colour words available, since everyone has seen the object and no explanation is needed. The traditional vocabulary has many of these food names: egg yolk, crab shell, duck egg, sweet bean paste, honey. All of them calibrate against something on the table. This sample is a fresh egg; in reality yolk colour varies widely with the hen's diet.
items.funZh: 蛋黄的颜色来自饲料里的类胡萝卜素 —— 鸡自己不会合成。所以喂玉米的鸡和喂青饲料的鸡，蛋黄深浅能差出好几档，而这个差别跟营养高低其实没有必然关系。
items.funEn: Yolk colour comes from carotenoids in the feed, which the hen cannot synthesise itself. A bird on maize and a bird on green forage can therefore lay yolks several steps apart in depth, and that difference has no necessary connection to how nutritious either egg is.

items.histZh: 松绿取松针的颜色，是偏冷的中深绿，比草绿沉、比竹青正。松在中国是「岁寒三友」之一，四季不凋，所以松绿这个色名天然带着「不变」的意思，常用在需要显得稳重的织物和器物上。它和松花色不要混：松花色是浅黄绿，说的是松树开花时那层黄，松绿说的才是叶子。屏幕上的松绿按老松针取色。
items.histEn: Pine green is the colour of the needle: a cool middle-to-deep green, heavier than grass and truer than bamboo. The pine is one of the three friends of winter, evergreen through the cold, so the colour word carries an implication of constancy and is used on textiles and objects that need to look settled. It should not be confused with pine flower, which is a pale yellow-green named after the pollen, not the foliage. This sample is taken from mature needles.
items.funZh: 松针其实是「长寿」的：一棵松树能保留三到五年的针叶，年年换一部分而不是一次掉光。所以同一棵松上，老针新针颜色差得很明显，远看是一层深一层浅，不是均匀的一块绿。
items.funEn: Pine needles are long-lived by leaf standards — a tree keeps each crop for three to five years and replaces them piecemeal rather than shedding all at once. On any one tree the old and new needles differ plainly in colour, so a pine reads as layers of dark and light rather than as one even green.

items.histZh: 翡翠最早是鸟名，说的是翠鸟；雌鸟羽毛偏红叫「翡」，雄鸟偏绿叫「翠」，合起来才成词。翡翠色取的正是翠鸟那种带蓝的绿，后来因为缅甸硬玉输入中国并占了「翡翠」这个名字，色名的原意反而被盖住了。它和青瓷的绿不同，饱和高、更冷。屏幕上的值按翠羽取色。
items.histEn: Jadeite began as a bird before it was a stone: the female kingfisher, whose plumage ran red, was fei, and the greener male was cui, and only together did the pair form the word. The colour named the bird's blue-leaning green, and when Burmese jadeite entered China and took over the name, the original sense was largely buried. It differs from celadon green in being more saturated and cooler. This value is taken from kingfisher plumage.
items.funZh: 点翠首饰用的就是翠鸟的羽毛，把羽枝剪下来贴到金属底托上，做成带光变的蓝绿。代价是杀鸟取羽，一只点翠凤冠要牺牲相当数量的翠鸟，所以清代以后一直有人反对，最后被烧蓝之类的工艺取代。
items.funEn: Traditional kingfisher jewellery was made by cutting the feather barbs and pasting them onto a metal base to produce an iridescent blue-green. The cost was taken from live birds, and a single ceremonial crown could consume a substantial number of them — an objection raised repeatedly from the Qing onward, until enamel techniques displaced the practice.

items.histZh: 荷绿取荷叶正面的颜色，是不偏黄也不偏蓝的正绿。荷叶在中文里的地位很高：既是「接天莲叶无穷碧」的景观，也是包吃食的材料，还入药。所以荷绿是个大众色名，用得很随意。屏幕上的荷绿按盛夏叶面取色，初生的嫩叶要浅得多，枯叶则转成褐。
items.histEn: Lotus green is the upper surface of the lotus leaf: a plain green leaning neither yellow nor blue. The lotus leaf is prominent in Chinese life — a spectacle in classical verse, a wrapping for food, and an ingredient in medicine — so the colour word is a popular one and used loosely. This sample is a midsummer leaf; newly opened leaves are much paler and dying ones go brown.
items.funZh: 荷叶不沾水，水珠在上面滚成一粒粒小球 —— 这是叶片表面的微纳结构造成的，跟化学涂层无关。这个效果后来被仿制成了「荷叶效应」的材料，也解释了为什么包着荷叶的吃食不容易被水汽泡软。
items.funEn: Water will not wet a lotus leaf; it beads into spheres that roll off. The effect comes from micro- and nanoscale structure on the surface rather than any chemical coating, and it was later copied as the lotus effect in materials science. It is also why food wrapped in a lotus leaf does not go soggy.

items.histZh: 玫瑰红取玫瑰花瓣的颜色，是带紫的深红，比绯更冷、比桃红更沉。玫瑰在中国原指一种美玉，《说文》里说「玫，火齐玫瑰」，后来才转指花。所以「玫瑰红」这个色名其实出现得不算早，是花名普及之后才定型的。屏幕上的玫瑰红按花瓣取色，不同品种之间差别极大。
items.histEn: Rose red is the petal: a deep red with purple in it, cooler than scarlet and heavier than peach. In early Chinese the two characters meant a kind of fine jade — the Shuowen glosses them that way — and only later attached themselves to the flower. The colour term is therefore comparatively young, fixing only once the plant name was widespread. This sample is taken from petals; the spread between cultivars is enormous.
items.funZh: 玫瑰花瓣的红色来自花青素，而花青素对酸碱极敏感：加酸更红，加碱转蓝。所以同一朵玫瑰的颜色会随细胞液的酸碱度浮动，用玫瑰花瓣煮水当指示剂，在旧时的实验里是可行的一招。
items.funEn: Rose petals get their red from anthocyanins, and anthocyanins are acutely sensitive to pH — more acid pushes them red, alkali pushes them blue. The colour of a given petal therefore drifts with the acidity of its cell sap, and boiling rose petals for use as an indicator genuinely worked in older laboratory practice.

items.histZh: 杨妃色是偏粉的浅红，名字直接来自杨玉环。传说她醉酒后的脸色被画工取作色样，于是「杨妃色」「妃色」一类的名目传了下来。这属于传统色里「以人命名」的一支，重点不在颜料，而在一个具体的人被记住的方式。屏幕上的杨妃色按工笔仕女画的敷色取色，实际用量很淡。
items.histEn: Consort Yang pink is a light red leaning toward pink, named directly after Yang Yuhuan, the celebrated consort of the Tang emperor Xuanzong. Tradition has it that painters took the flush of her face after drinking as a colour sample, and names of this type passed into the vocabulary. It belongs to the personal branch of Chinese colour naming, where what is being recorded is less a pigment than the way a particular person was remembered. This value follows the washes of court figure painting, where the pigment is used very thin.
items.funZh: 拿人的脸色定色样，在今天看有点奇怪，但在没有标准色卡的年代是可行的办法 —— 只要那个人足够有名，大家就有共同的参照。杨妃色、西施色、洛神珠这一类色名，本质上都是「用一个公众人物当色卡」。
items.funEn: Fixing a colour by reference to a person's complexion looks odd now, but it worked in the absence of standard swatches: so long as the person was famous enough, everyone shared the reference. A handful of Chinese colour names are essentially public figures pressed into service as colour cards.

items.histZh: 缟是未经染色的白绢，所以「缟色」说的是生绢那种带一点暖灰的白，不是漂出来的纯白。《战国策》里有「强弩之末，势不能穿鲁缟」，鲁缟是鲁地产的薄绢，白而细，薄到能被箭穿 —— 一个颜色名是拿它的薄出名的。屏幕上的缟色按生绢取色，实际生绢偏黄，需要反复漂洗才变白。
items.histEn: Gao is undyed white silk, so gao colour means the faintly warm, greyish white of raw woven silk rather than the pure white of bleaching. The Warring States texts contain a proverb about a spent crossbow bolt being unable to pierce Lu silk, the fine thin fabric of Lu — the colour word is remembered for its thinness. This sample is raw silk; in reality raw silk runs yellow and needs repeated washing before it reads white.
items.funZh: 「缟素」在古书里常常直接等于丧服 —— 不染色就穿，恰好符合丧礼去饰的要求。所以缟色这个色名背着两层意思：一层是「最朴素的丝」，一层是「有丧事」。同一个颜色，语境不同分量差得很远。
items.funEn: In older Chinese the phrase for gao and plain white routinely means mourning dress, since leaving cloth undyed satisfies the requirement to strip ornament from a funeral. The colour therefore carries two meanings at once: the plainest possible silk, and a death in the family. Context does all the work.

items.histZh: 皂色是用皂斗之类的栎树虫瘿染出来的黑，色不纯正，带一点褐，是平民衣料最常见的一档黑。皂色在旧时地位很低，皂吏、皂隶穿的就是它，所以这个字后来直接成了杂役的代称。它不是「黑」的正宗 —— 正宗的黑叫玄、叫墨，皂色是能大规模染出来、人人都穿得起的那种黑。屏幕上的值按旧布取色。
items.histEn: Soap black was dyed with oak galls and related tannins. It never came out pure, carrying a brown cast, and it was the ordinary black of common cloth. Its status was low: the runners and bailiffs of a yamen wore it, which is how the character came to stand for menial office. It is not the orthodox black — that is called xuan or mo — but the black that could be dyed at scale and afforded by anyone. This value is from old cloth.
items.funZh: 「皂」和「白」在中国是天生的一对反义词，但有意思的是，「不分青红皂白」里的皂其实代表「黑」，而青和红代表两色 —— 这句话本身就点明了老底子的三原色体系：青、红、皂、白，四种。
items.funEn: Soap and white form a natural pair of opposites in Chinese, but the idiom about refusing to distinguish blue from red, soap from white is itself informative: blue, red, soap and white are named together there, which is roughly the classical four-colour set.

items.histZh: 缁是黑色的帛，比皂色正、比墨色浅一点，带极淡的蓝灰。《诗经》里「缁衣之宜兮」写的是黑色的朝服，说明先秦它还是正经礼服的颜色；佛教传入以后僧众穿缁衣，这个字就渐渐跟出家人绑在了一起，「缁流」「缁门」都指僧团。屏幕上的缁色按古绢取色。
items.histEn: Zi is black silk: truer than soap black and a shade lighter than ink, with the faintest blue-grey in it. The Book of Songs praises the fit of a black robe, which shows that in pre-Qin times it was a proper ceremonial colour. After Buddhism arrived and monks took to black robes, the character attached itself to the monastic orders — the black stream and the black gate both mean the clergy. The value shown is from old silk.
items.funZh: 染黑比染别的颜色更考验工艺：天然染料要反复浸染、还要靠媒染剂把颜色固定住，一道不到位就发褐。所以古代「能穿一身不掉色的黑」本身是身份的标志，深色衣服从来比浅色的贵。
items.funEn: Black is harder to dye well than most colours. Natural dyes require repeated dipping and a mordant to fix the result, and one insufficient pass leaves you with brown instead of black. Wearing black that does not fade was therefore a marker of means: dark cloth has always cost more than pale.

items.histZh: 天水碧的来历在南唐的记载里有点传奇：一位宫人把染好的碧色绢晾在院子里忘了收，露水落了一夜，第二天颜色竟比原来好看，于是这个色被叫做天水碧 —— 意思是天给的。它比一般的碧色淡、偏青白，从此在南唐宫廷里风行。屏幕上的天水碧按传说描述的成色复原，实际靠露水染出稳定颜色并不可靠。
items.histEn: The origin story recorded from the Southern Tang is half legend: a palace woman left freshly dyed green silk out overnight, dew settled on it, and the colour came out better than before — so the shade was called heaven-water green, meaning it was given by the sky. It runs paler and bluer than an ordinary green, and it took hold at the Southern Tang court. The value shown is a reconstruction from the description; in practice dew is not a dependable way to fix a colour.
items.funZh: 用露水染色的说法在工艺上站不太住：露水是中性偏微酸的，很难成为有效媒染剂。比较合理的解释是夜间潮湿让染料多做了一次渗透，或者那批绢本来就有杂质在起作用。传说往往给偶然加了一层必然的外衣。
items.funEn: The dew story does not hold up technically. Dew is roughly neutral, maybe faintly acid, and makes a poor mordant. A likelier explanation is that overnight damp let the dye penetrate once more, or that impurities already in that batch of silk did the work. Legend tends to dress coincidence in the clothes of necessity.

items.histZh: 秋波蓝取秋天水面那种偏冷偏深、带一点灰的蓝。秋天水体清澈、日照角度低，反射光比夏天冷，所以秋水在观感上确实比夏水蓝。这个色名后来被引申得很远 —— 「秋波」在汉语里成了眼神的代称，所谓「暗送秋波」，其实是从颜色借来的一个比喻。屏幕上的值按秋日湖面取色。
items.histEn: Autumn ripple blue is the cool, deeper, slightly greyed blue of water in autumn. A low sun and clearer water scatter and reflect differently than in summer, so autumn water genuinely does read bluer. The term later travelled a long way from colour: autumn ripple became a byword for a glance, so that the phrase for sending a covert look is borrowed directly from this shade. The sample is a lake surface in autumn.
items.funZh: 「秋水」在汉语里还指剑，所谓「延平剑」一类典故里的秋水就是剑光。于是同一个词身上叠了三层：真正的秋天水面、人的眼神、以及兵器反光 —— 都是从「冷而亮」这一个共同点长出来的。
items.funEn: Autumn water in Chinese also means a sword; several classical allusions use it for the glint of a blade. One word thus carries three layers — the actual surface of autumn water, a person's glance, and a weapon's reflection — all of them branching from the single shared quality of being cold and bright.

items.histZh: 紫薇色取紫薇花的花色，是明快的红紫。紫薇这种植物在中文里名字很重：唐代中书省曾改称紫薇省，因为省中多种紫薇，于是「紫薇郎」成了中书舍人的别称。所以紫薇色带着一层官署气，虽然它本身只是夏末很常见的一种花。屏幕上的紫薇色按盛花取色，不同品种有紫有红有白。
items.histEn: Crape myrtle purple is the colour of the blossom: a bright red-purple. The plant carries an unusually heavy name in Chinese. The Tang secretariat was once renamed the crape myrtle office because the tree grew throughout its grounds, and the phrase crape myrtle gentleman became a nickname for its junior officials. The colour therefore carries a whiff of government office, even though the tree itself is an ordinary late-summer bloom. This sample is at full flower; cultivars range from purple through red to white.
items.funZh: 紫薇还有一个别名叫「痒痒树」，据说轻轻挠树干它就会动。这个说法在植物学上没有确证，但紫薇的树干确实光滑无皮，上部枝条又细又软，风一吹就晃，看起来确实像被挠到了。
items.funEn: Crape myrtle has a folk nickname meaning ticklish tree, on the claim that scratching the trunk makes it move. Botanically this is unconfirmed, but the trunk is genuinely smooth and barkless and the upper twigs are thin and whippy, so wind alone makes it sway as though something had touched it.

items.histZh: 桑紫取成熟桑葚的颜色，是深而不艳的紫，带一点青灰。桑在中国是最要紧的树之一 —— 养蚕要它，所以古代把桑与农并称，「农桑」就是整个生计。桑葚成熟时紫得发黑，一碰就染色，小孩吃完满嘴满手都是。屏幕上的桑紫按熟果取色，未熟的桑葚先是青红再转黑紫。
items.histEn: Mulberry purple is the ripe fruit: a deep, unshowy purple with a greenish grey in it. The mulberry is one of the most consequential trees in China, since silkworms eat it and the old pairing of farming and mulberry stood for the whole economy. Ripe mulberries are so dark a purple that they stain on contact, and children come away with purple mouths and hands. This sample is ripe fruit; unripe berries pass from green to red before turning black-purple.
items.funZh: 桑葚的染色能力来自花青素，跟葡萄、蓝莓是一类。这类色素对酸碱极敏感，所以手上的桑葚汁用碱性的肥皂不容易洗掉，反而会往蓝紫走 —— 用一点酸性的果汁或者柠檬汁帮忙反而更有效。
items.funEn: The staining power of a mulberry comes from anthocyanins, the same family as grapes and blueberries. These pigments shift with pH, so alkaline soap tends to push the stain toward blue-violet rather than lifting it, and an acidic rinse such as lemon juice does better.

items.histZh: 乌梅紫取烟熏干制的乌梅颜色，是带红调的暗紫，近看几乎是褐。乌梅是中国传统的一味主药，酸得厉害，夏天煮酸梅汤正是用它。因为乌梅是熏干的，表面那层颜色混了烟火气，所以这个紫不干净、带烟。屏幕上的乌梅紫按干果取色，鲜梅子完全不是这个颜色。
items.histEn: Smoked plum purple is the colour of the dried, smoke-cured plum used in Chinese medicine: a dark red-cast purple that reads almost brown up close. Smoked plums are sharply sour and are the base of the summer drink known as sour plum soup. Because the fruit is cured over smoke, the surface colour carries something of the fire, which is why this purple is not clean. The sample is dried fruit; a fresh plum looks nothing like it.
items.funZh: 酸梅汤里那点烟熏味是乌梅给的，不是靠香料调出来的。熏制这一步既防腐又增味，代价是成品颜色深到发黑 —— 所以「乌梅紫」这个色名其实描述的是一种加工工艺的结果，不是果实的本色。
items.funEn: The smoky note in sour plum soup comes from how the fruit is cured, not from added spice. That curing step preserves the plum and deepens its flavour, at the cost of driving the colour almost black. Smoked plum purple therefore describes the outcome of a process rather than the fruit's own colour.

items.histZh: 芥蓝绿取芥蓝菜叶的青绿，是偏冷的中绿，比荷绿深、比松绿正。芥蓝在岭南是最常见的时蔬之一，做法讲究猛火快炒，颜色要保持脆绿，所以这个色名在粤地尤其实用 —— 说「炒到芥蓝绿」，大家立刻知道是什么火候。屏幕上的芥蓝绿按断生时取色，煮过头就会转黄褐。
items.histEn: Kale green is the colour of the Chinese kale leaf: a cool middle green, deeper than lotus and truer than pine. The vegetable is a staple of southern Chinese cooking, where the technique calls for a hard, fast toss so that the colour stays bright and crisp — which makes the colour word genuinely useful in Cantonese kitchens, since an instruction to fry it to kale green is instantly understood as a specification of doneness. This sample is just past raw; overcooked, it browns.
items.funZh: 绿叶菜一过火就发黄，是因为叶绿素在受热和遇酸时会脱掉中心的镁，变成脱镁叶绿素，颜色转成暗橄榄绿。所以「保持翠绿」这件事有化学依据，不是纯粹的审美偏好 —— 炒得快的确更绿。
items.funEn: Leafy greens yellow when overcooked because chlorophyll loses the magnesium at its centre under heat and acid and becomes pheophytin, an olive-drab pigment. Keeping a stir-fry green is therefore chemistry rather than aesthetics: cooking fast genuinely leaves more of the original colour intact.

items.histZh: 橄榄绿取橄榄果实的颜色，是发暗发灰的黄绿，处在黄绿与褐的交界。橄榄在中国南方既是果树也是药材，果实先涩后回甘，所谓「谏果」，意思像忠言。颜色上这一档很低调，明度跟饱和度都不高，用作衣料显得耐脏耐看。屏幕上的橄榄绿按青果取色，成熟果转黑紫。
items.histEn: Olive green is the colour of the fruit: a dark, greyed yellow-green sitting on the border with brown. The olive is both a crop and a medicine in southern China, and its taste runs from astringent to sweet, which earned it the name admonition fruit — bitter at first, like honest advice. As a colour it is thoroughly modest, low in both lightness and saturation, and it wears well on cloth. This sample is a green fruit; ripe ones turn black-purple.
items.funZh: 橄榄油的颜色其实跟橄榄果不完全对应：冷压初榨的油偏绿，是因为油里带着叶绿素，而不是果肉本身的颜色。放久或见光，叶绿素降解，油会慢慢转向金黄 —— 这跟绿叶菜变黄是同一个机理。
items.funEn: Olive oil does not match the fruit exactly. Cold-pressed virgin oil runs green because it carries chlorophyll from the fruit rather than because the flesh is green. Left in light, that chlorophyll degrades and the oil drifts toward gold, by the same chemistry that turns a cooked green vegetable yellow.

items.histZh: 新绿是春天叶片刚展开时的颜色，黄多绿少，鲜而薄。新叶之所以比老叶黄，是因为叶绿素还没合成完，叶黄素之类的辅助色素一时占了上风 —— 所以这是一档「正在变绿、还没绿完」的颜色。它在中国诗文里几乎等同于早春，跟柳绿是近邻。屏幕上的新绿按发芽一周内取色。
items.histEn: New leaf green is the colour of a leaf just unfurled: more yellow than green, bright and thin. Young leaves read yellower than mature ones because chlorophyll has not finished forming and the accessory pigments temporarily dominate — this is a colour caught mid-transition, on its way to being green. In Chinese poetry it functions as a synonym for early spring, a close neighbour of willow green. This sample is from the first week after budbreak.
items.funZh: 秋天的黄叶和新叶的黄是两回事：新叶是把叶绿素还没造出来，秋叶是把叶绿素拆掉了，露出本来一直躲在下面的类胡萝卜素。所以春天和秋天的黄长得像，成因正好相反。
items.funEn: The yellow of a spring leaf and the yellow of an autumn leaf are not the same thing. A young leaf has not yet built its chlorophyll; an autumn leaf has dismantled the chlorophyll it had and revealed carotenoids that were underneath all along. Spring and autumn look alike while running the opposite chemistry.

items.histZh: 嫩黄是掺了大量白的浅黄，参考的是雏鸟绒毛和初生叶芽那一类颜色。它明度极高、饱和极低，属于黄里最轻的一档，用起来很挑底 —— 放在白上几乎看不出，放在深色上才跳出来。传统色里「嫩」字开头的色名都含这一层「刚长出来」的意思：嫩黄、嫩绿、嫩红。屏幕上的嫩黄按雏鸟绒毛取色。
items.histEn: Tender yellow is a pale yellow carrying a great deal of white, calibrated against the down of a chick or the first shoots of a bud. Very high in lightness and very low in saturation, it is the lightest of the yellows and awkward to use: against white it nearly disappears, against anything dark it jumps. Chinese colour words beginning with tender all carry that sense of just grown — tender yellow, tender green, tender red. This sample is chick down.
items.funZh: 浅色在色彩学里有个反直觉的性质：它们看起来的「颜色」往往比实际测出来的更明显。一块 #F7E7A1 单独看是淡黄，并排放到纯白旁边，黄会显得浓得多 —— 这就是为什么近白色一定要成组看才准。
items.funEn: Very light colours behave counter-intuitively. A pale yellow seen alone reads as pale yellow, but place it beside a pure white and it becomes visibly yellower. This is why near-whites can only be judged in company, never one at a time.

items.histZh: 蜜色取蜂蜜和蜂蜡的颜色，是带橙的暖黄，明度中偏亮。它跟琥珀色是近亲，但琥珀更深更透，蜜色更淡更软。蜜色在传统色里属温和一路，不刺眼，常用于形容皮肤、灯光和陈放久了的纸张。屏幕上的蜜色按结晶蜜取色，不同花源的蜜颜色差别很大。
items.histEn: Honey is the colour of honey and beeswax: a warm yellow with orange in it, middling to light in value. It is a close relative of amber, but amber runs deeper and more transparent while honey is paler and softer. In the traditional palette it sits among the gentle tones, never glaring, and it turns up describing skin, lamplight and paper that has aged. This sample is crystallised honey; the colour varies widely with the flowers the bees worked.
items.funZh: 蜂蜜结晶是正常的物理过程，不是掺糖 —— 葡萄糖会从过饱和溶液里析出成晶体，温度在十几度时最容易发生。结晶蜜颜色往往比液态时浅，同一罐蜜放一个冬天，颜色就能挪动一档。
items.funEn: Crystallisation in honey is a normal physical process rather than evidence of added sugar: glucose comes out of a supersaturated solution as crystals, most readily around the low teens in Celsius. Crystallised honey usually reads paler than the liquid, so a single jar can shift a step in colour across one winter.

items.histZh: 黛蓝是黛色偏蓝的那一头。黛本是画眉用的青黑色颜料，出自蓝草加工的副产品「青黛」，所以它天然带蓝。传统用法里，黛偏灰黑，黛蓝偏青蓝，两者是同一个词根下拉开的两档。它常用于形容远山、暮色和深色织物。屏幕上的黛蓝按青黛颜料取色，研得越细越偏蓝灰。
items.histEn: Dai indigo blue is the blue end of the dai family. Dai was originally the blue-black pigment used to paint eyebrows, produced as a by-product of indigo processing, so blue is inherent in it. In traditional usage dai leans grey-black while dai indigo leans cyan-blue — two steps pulled apart from one root. It describes distant hills, dusk, and dark cloth. This sample is the pigment itself; the finer it is ground, the more it shifts toward blue-grey.
items.funZh: 青黛既是颜料也是药，中医拿它清热凉血，出自加工蓝靛时的浮沫。同一缸染料的产物被分成两种用途：沉下去的是染料，浮起来的是药和眉墨 —— 一种植物，三条出路。
items.funEn: Indigo sediment served as both pigment and medicine, prescribed in Chinese pharmacology to clear heat. It is the froth skimmed during indigo processing. One dye vat therefore yielded three products: what sank, used for dyeing; what floated, used for brows and for prescriptions.

items.histZh: 藕粉是莲藕磨浆沉淀出的淀粉，冲熟之后是半透明的浅粉灰，这个色名取的就是它。它跟藕荷、藕色是一家人，都从藕身上来：藕荷偏紫，藕色偏肉，藕粉最浅最粉。藕粉在旧时是江南常见的代餐与病后调理品，所以这个色名带着一点家常的温软。屏幕上的藕粉按冲熟的糊取色。
items.histEn: Lotus root pink is the starch settled out of ground lotus root, and the colour is what that starch looks like once it has been poured over with hot water and turned translucent. It belongs with the other lotus-root names: the shade called lotus-root lotus leans purple, lotus-root flesh leans pinkish tan, and this is the palest and pinkest. Lotus starch was a common restorative food in the Jiangnan region, so the colour carries a soft domesticity. This sample is the prepared paste.
items.funZh: 藕粉要用滚水冲，而且得先用一点凉水把粉调开 —— 直接浇开水会结块。这个「先凉后热」的步骤跟冲其他淀粉一样，本质是让颗粒先均匀分散，再一次性糊化。
items.funEn: Lotus starch has to be brought together with a little cold water first and only then hit with boiling water; pour the hot straight onto dry powder and it lumps. The two-step method, shared with other starches, first disperses the granules evenly so that they can all gelatinise at once.

items.histZh: 豆沙色取红豆沙的颜色，是发暗发灰的红褐，饱和很低。它在中国点心里是最常见的馅料色，月饼、汤圆、粽子都少不了，所以这个色名普及度极高，几乎是「有甜味感的暗红」的代称。红豆沙的真正颜色其实取决于煮的程度和加不加糖，从红褐到深黑都有。屏幕上的豆沙色按常见成品取色。
items.histEn: Sweet bean paste is the colour of red bean paste: a dark, greyed red-brown of low saturation. As the standard filling of Chinese sweets — mooncakes, glutinous rice balls, leaf-wrapped dumplings — the name is extremely widely understood and functions almost as a shorthand for a dark red that tastes sweet. The actual colour depends on how long the beans are cooked and whether sugar is added, running from red-brown to near black. The sample is a typical finished paste.
items.funZh: 「豆沙」这个词有个很有意思的错位：它原本说的是豆子煮烂后连皮压成的沙状物，所以「沙」形容的是口感而不是颜色。今天「豆沙色」被当成一个颜色词用，等于口感跑到了视觉上。
items.funEn: The Chinese word for this paste describes texture rather than colour: sand names the granular mouthfeel of cooked, mashed beans. Its use as a colour term is therefore a small category error in which a tactile quality has migrated into the visual.

items.histZh: 秋色取秋天草木转黄时的整体调子，是带灰的暖黄褐，不鲜也不闷。汉语里「秋色」常常不指某一个具体色相，而是指一个季节总体的色彩气氛 —— 黄、褐、赭、橙混在一起的那个感觉。所以严格说它是个「场景色」，落成一个色号只是给它找个代表。屏幕上的秋色按落叶林平均值取色。
items.histEn: Autumn ochre takes the overall tone of foliage turning in autumn: a warm yellow-brown with grey in it, neither bright nor dull. In Chinese, autumn colour frequently does not name a single hue but the general chromatic mood of a season — the mixed impression of yellows, browns, ochres and oranges together. Strictly speaking it is a scene rather than a swatch, and assigning one value to it means choosing a representative. This sample is the average of deciduous woodland.
items.funZh: 落叶变色的顺序是有规律的：先黄后褐，因为类胡萝卜素比较稳定、花青素则要看天气。干燥晴朗的秋天容易出红叶，湿冷多雨的秋天多半只是黄 —— 所以「秋色」每年并不一样。
items.funEn: The sequence of autumn colour is regular: yellow first, brown after, because carotenoids are relatively stable while anthocyanins depend on weather. A dry, bright autumn produces reds; a wet, cold one mostly manages yellow. Autumn colour is therefore not the same thing twice.

items.histZh: 相思灰取红豆（相思子）的种皮底色，是带一点暖红的灰。相思子在中文里是相思的象征，王维那首「红豆生南国」几乎人人会背，所以这个色名的重量全在文学上，颜色本身只是一档不起眼的暖灰。屏幕上的相思灰按种子取色，真正的相思子红黑相间，单取一色并不准确。
items.histEn: Lovesick grey is the base tone of the seed coat of the lovesick bean, a warm grey with a hint of red in it. That bean is the standard Chinese emblem of longing, fixed in the popular memory by Wang Wei's poem about it growing in the south, so the weight of this colour name is entirely literary while the shade itself is an unremarkable warm grey. This sample is taken from the seed; the real seed is two-toned red and black, so a single value is a simplification.
items.funZh: 相思子（鸡母珠）的种子有剧毒，是相思豆里最危险的一种 —— 外壳完好时没事，一旦破损，里面的毒蛋白足以致命。所以「红豆生南国」里的红豆到底指哪一种，学界其实一直有争议，未必就是它。
items.funEn: The seed known as the lovesick bean is severely toxic, one of the most dangerous of the plants called red beans: intact it is harmless, but once the coat is broken the protein inside can be lethal. Which plant Wang Wei actually meant has been debated for a long time, and it may not have been this one at all.

items.histZh: 苍色是灰中带青的一档，来源之一是「苍天」—— 天不是蓝的，是苍的，也就是带灰的青。苍在中文里意义很宽：苍老、苍茫、苍凉，都从「褪了色的、没有边际的」这个感觉上来，所以它更像个形容词性的颜色。屏幕上的苍色按阴天远景取色，晴天时它会更蓝。
items.histEn: Cang grey is a grey with blue in it, one source being the classical phrase for the heavens, where the sky is not blue but cang — a greyed blue. The character ranges widely in Chinese, turning up in words for old age, for vastness, for desolation, all built on a sense of the faded and the boundless, which makes it more adjective than swatch. This sample is an overcast distant view; in clear weather the same scene runs bluer.
items.funZh: 汉语里颜色的边界很松，「苍」可以指灰青的天、指深绿的松、也可以指发白的头发。看它到底指哪一色，得靠后面那个字：苍天、苍松、苍鹰、苍老 —— 同一个「苍」，落到不同对象上就换了个颜色。
items.funEn: Chinese draws colour boundaries loosely. Cang can describe a grey-blue sky, a deep green pine, or whitening hair. Which one it means is decided by the noun that follows: cang sky, cang pine, cang hawk, cang with age. One character, several colours, sorted by context.

items.histZh: 槐黄是用国槐的花蕾染出来的黄，色比栀黄稍绿、比藤黄稳，是中国传统黄色染料里很重要的一支。槐花未开时叫「槐米」，是专门的染料药材，收下来晒干备用。这个色名因此跟农时连着：收槐米的日子是固定的，错过了花就开了、染料就废了。屏幕上的槐黄按新染样布取色。
items.histEn: Pagoda tree yellow comes from the flower buds of the Chinese scholar tree: slightly greener than gardenia yellow and steadier than gamboge, one of the more important traditional yellow dyes. The unopened buds, known as huaimi, were harvested and dried specifically for dyeing and medicine. The colour name is therefore tied to the agricultural calendar, since the buds have to be gathered in a fixed window before they open and the dye is lost. This sample is freshly dyed cloth.
items.funZh: 槐米染色得靠媒染剂定色，古法常加明矾 —— 加了之后黄更亮更牢，不加则偏土、易褪。同一锅染料，媒染剂换了，出来的颜色能差出两种色名，这也是古代染色配方要严格保密的实际原因。
items.funEn: Sophora buds need a mordant to fix the dye, and the traditional choice was alum: with it the yellow comes out brighter and faster, without it earthier and quick to fade. One dye bath and two different colour names, depending on the mordant — which is the practical reason old dye recipes were carefully guarded.

items.histZh: 霁蓝是明代宣德官窑的一种高温蓝釉，以钴为呈色剂，色调深沉匀净，釉面不流不裂，又叫「祭蓝」—— 因为它专门用来烧祭祀用的器皿，跟祭红是一对。霁蓝很少带纹饰，多为素器，因为釉色本身就是它全部的说服力。屏幕上的霁蓝按传世器取色，深釉在强光下会显出一层宝光。
items.histEn: Ji blue is a high-fired blue glaze of the Ming Xuande imperial kilns, coloured with cobalt: deep, even and sober, with no running or crazing. It is also called altar blue, since it was made specifically for ritual vessels and forms a pair with altar red. Ji blue is usually left undecorated, because the glaze is the whole argument. The sample is taken from a surviving piece; under strong light the thick glaze shows an oily sheen.
items.funZh: 高温蓝釉比青花更难做：青花是釉下彩，画上去再罩釉；霁蓝是整器上一个色，要求釉面厚薄一致、发色均匀，只要有一点厚薄不匀就会花。所以传世的霁蓝器里，色匀的少。
items.funEn: A monochrome high-fired blue is harder than blue-and-white. Painted cobalt sits under the glaze and forgives variation; a Ji blue vessel is dipped whole and must come out uniform, and the slightest unevenness in thickness shows as blotching. Survivors with a really even colour are few.

items.histZh: 苋红取炒苋菜时那锅红紫的汤汁颜色，是偏冷的深红。苋菜在中国南方是最普通的夏季蔬菜，一炒就出红汤，把米饭染成粉色是很多人小时候的记忆。这个色名因此带着强烈的家常气，跟「玫瑰红」那种取花取玉的命名路子完全两样。屏幕上的苋红按汤汁取色，实际叶片的红集中在叶心。
items.histEn: Amaranth red is the purplish red of the cooking water when amaranth is stir-fried: a cool, deep red. The vegetable is an ordinary summer green in southern China, and it releases a red liquor the moment it hits the pan, dyeing the rice pink — a childhood memory for a great many people. The colour name is therefore thoroughly domestic, taking its cue from a kitchen rather than a garden or a gemstone. This sample is the cooking liquor; on the plant the red concentrates at the centre of the leaf.
items.funZh: 苋菜的红汤来自甜菜红素，这类色素水溶性极强，所以焯一下就全跑到水里了。它怕高温久煮，煮久了颜色会发暗发褐 —— 想留住那个红，得控制时间，或者干脆连汤一起吃掉。
items.funEn: The red comes from betalains, pigments that are extremely water-soluble, which is why a brief blanch pulls them straight into the water. They also darken and brown with prolonged heat, so keeping the colour means controlling the cooking time — or simply eating the liquor along with the vegetable.

items.histZh: 荔枝色取荔枝果壳成熟时的红，是带褐的暖红，不鲜但厚。荔枝在中文里地位特殊：它从岭南送往长安的故事让「一骑红尘妃子笑」成了名句，而荔枝自己又极不耐放，一日色变、二日香变、三日味变，所以「荔枝色」也隐约带着「好看但留不住」的意思。屏幕上的荔枝色按熟果取色，品种之间从青红到深红都有。
items.histEn: Lychee red is the colour of a ripe lychee shell: a warm red with brown in it, never bright but solid. The fruit has an unusual standing in Chinese, since the story of it being rushed to the capital for a favourite consort produced one of the best-known lines in the poetry of the Tang — and because lychees keep so badly that colour changes in a day, scent in two and flavour in three, the colour word carries a faint suggestion of beauty that will not hold. This sample is ripe fruit; cultivars range from green-red to deep red.
items.funZh: 荔枝不耐放的原因之一是它的壳看着厚实，其实不密封，水分很快散掉，糖分又容易被自身的酶消耗。古人早就总结出了保鲜的办法：连枝叶一起、用竹筒或者浸水的容器装，尽量缩短从树到嘴的时间。
items.funEn: Part of why lychees keep badly is that the shell looks substantial but does not seal: water escapes quickly and the fruit's own enzymes consume its sugars. Traditional practice already worked out the answer — keep the fruit on the branch, pack it in bamboo tubes or water-soaked containers, and shorten the journey from tree to mouth as much as possible.

items.histZh: 桐绿取梧桐叶的绿色，是明亮而正的中绿，比荷绿稍黄。梧桐在中国文化里是招凤的树，「凤非梧桐不栖」的说法让它带了一层贵气，秋天的「梧桐一叶落」又成了季节交替的信号。所以桐绿其实是个有节令感的色名：叶刚绿时是初夏，绿透时是盛夏。屏幕上的桐绿按盛叶取色。
items.histEn: Phoenix tree green is the colour of the scholar tree's leaf: a bright, true middle green, slightly yellower than lotus. The tree has a distinguished place in Chinese culture as the perch of the phoenix — the bird will settle on no other — and the fall of a single leaf signals the turn of the season. The colour word therefore carries a sense of the calendar: first green means early summer, full green high summer. This sample is a mature leaf.
items.funZh: 「一叶知秋」说的就是梧桐。这个说法有几分道理：梧桐叶片大、对温度和日照变化的反应早，加上落叶时容易整片脱落，视觉上确实比别的树先显出秋意。所以古人把梧桐当节令的报时钟，不是随便挑的一棵树。
items.funEn: The classical phrase about knowing autumn from a single falling leaf refers to this tree. There is something to it: the leaves are large, they respond early to shifts in temperature and day length, and they tend to drop whole rather than shredding, so the tree does show autumn before its neighbours.

items.histZh: 竹月说的是月亮底下的竹子 —— 夜里没有色觉，竹叶反射的光落到眼睛里的量低到视锥细胞使不上劲，于是绿色被洗掉，剩下的是灰蓝。这个色名很准确地抓住了一个真实的视觉现象：暗光下的颜色不是「暗一点的绿」，而是灰蓝。屏幕上的竹月按满月的竹林取色。
items.histEn: Bamboo moon names bamboo seen in moonlight. At night there is effectively no colour vision: the light reflected from the leaves is too weak to drive the cone cells, so the green is washed out and what remains is grey-blue. The term captures a real visual effect quite precisely — a colour seen in dim light is not a darker version of itself but a different, desaturated colour. This sample is a bamboo grove under a full moon.
items.funZh: 暗光下看什么都偏灰蓝，是因为负责色彩视锥细胞在低照度下基本停摆，剩下管明暗的视杆细胞顶上，而它不区分颜色。所以「夜里的绿色」在生理上就不存在，竹月这个色名等于是古人对这个现象的命名。
items.funEn: Everything greys and blues in dim light because the cone cells that handle colour largely shut down at low illumination and the rods take over, and rods do not discriminate hue. Green at night is therefore not physiologically available. Bamboo moon amounts to the Chinese vocabulary giving that fact a name.

items.histZh: 桂黄取桂花的颜色，是带橙的暖黄。桂花在中文里是很重的意象：秋日、月亮、科举，「蟾宫折桂」讲的是中举，所以桂黄沾着一层吉庆气。花色本身从乳白到橙红都有，金桂偏黄、丹桂偏橙，桂黄取的是中间那一路。屏幕上的桂黄按金桂盛花取色，真实花色比这个更淡、更碎。
items.histEn: Osmanthus yellow is the blossom colour: a warm yellow with orange in it. The flower has a heavy load of association in Chinese — autumn, the moon, the imperial examinations, since the phrase for plucking osmanthus in the toad palace means passing them — so the colour carries a festive charge. The blossom itself runs from cream to orange-red, with golden varieties leaning yellow and cinnabar varieties orange; this value sits between them. The sample is a golden osmanthus in full flower; the real thing is paler and more scattered.
items.funZh: 桂花的香气浓得不像话，靠的是花里几种挥发性酯类和紫罗兰酮。它开花期短、花又小，所以采花全靠人工抖落。也正因为香气集中，桂花能做成糖渍、酿酒而不必用很多量。
items.funEn: Osmanthus is disproportionately fragrant for its size, which comes down to a handful of volatile esters and ionones in the petals. The flowering window is short and the flowers are tiny, so harvesting is done by shaking them from the branch by hand. Because the scent is so concentrated, a small quantity carries through into sugar preserves and into wine.
